body: Kingdom Under Fire: Heroes is Blueside and Phantagram's action and real-time tactics game, first released for Xbox on 20 September 2005. Its campaigns revisit characters from The Crusaders, following events before and during that earlier story. The player commands groups of soldiers across large fantasy battles, then directly controls a hero when the commanding unit enters combat. These two perspectives are connected. The immediate fight takes place inside an army whose position and composition have already been shaped by decisions made from the broader battlefield view.

Each army group contains its own soldiers, and the player's available forces include regular units and specialised support. Directing them effectively means considering more than the enemies surrounding the hero. Another group may need to move, provide assistance or confront a threat elsewhere. New elemental units, including Fire Wraiths and Earth Golems, broaden the available combinations. The player alternates between the satisfaction of landing attacks personally and the responsibility of keeping several formations useful. A powerful commander still depends on an army that reaches the right position and engages an appropriate target.

Ellen, Leinhart, Urukubarr, Rupert, Cirith, Morene and Walter each receive a campaign, allowing the conflict to be approached through different characters and time periods. Some stories begin five years before The Crusaders, while others take place alongside it. This structure expands the setting without abandoning the relationship between battlefield command and direct action. A Windows edition followed in 2020. Heroes is most distinctive when the two forms of control reinforce one another: the player's personal intervention matters because it takes place within a larger battle that still needs to be managed.
